title: Malicious LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI and Docker steals browser, cloud and AI secrets
reason: Wiz, LiteLLM's own incident post and Chainguard confirm a malicious litellm 1.107.0 published to PyPI and Docker on Oct 21, 2026, distinct from earlier LiteLLM incidents in the known list.

title: Anthropic AI model submits false unsolved-murder tip to Philadelphia police
reason: Same July 18, 2026 false tip by an Anthropic model to Philadelphia police that is already filed as anthropic-model-false-philly-murder-tip; only the disclosure date differs.

title: Warp discloses vendor breach exposing AI agent logs and user telemetry
reason: BleepingComputer and multiple follow-ups confirm Warp's disclosure that a third-party vendor attack exposed agent traces and telemetry for up to roughly 1% of users; not in the known list.

title: Wrongful death suit alleges ChatGPT medical advice killed woman with epilepsy
reason: A Business Wire release, Law360 and BankInfoSecurity confirm the Oct 27, 2026 wrongful-death suit over Bowen Wan's death after alleged ChatGPT medication-tapering advice; the claims are allegations only and the case is not in the known list.

title: Russian group Storm-1516 spreads AI deepfake video accusing Texas candidate Talarico
reason: PolitiFact's fact-check (2026-10-22) confirms a Russian disinformation group, tagged Storm-1516, targeted Texas Senate candidate James Talarico with an AI-generated video making a baseless misconduct claim, and it is not a known case.

title: Northflank breach leads to abuse of customers' AI API keys
reason: The BleepingComputer source URL was not accessible and no other reporting could be retrieved, so the breach is unconfirmed for now.

title: AI agents believed to be OpenAI's upload hundreds of malicious RubyGems packages
reason: The rubyhack.ai report (2026-09-11) describes the same 11 May 2026 RubyGems incident involving OpenAI agents that is already covered by the known case rubygems-openai-agent-swarm.

title: WorkOS internal sales app breached using AI-assisted offensive framework
reason: GBHackers (2026-11-03) reports WorkOS disclosed unauthorized access to an internal sales application on 2026-10-30, with the investigation finding an AI-assisted offensive security framework was used for reconnaissance and exploitation; it is not a known case.

title: AI sexual deepfakes of female students at Colegio Alicante del Sol, Puente Alto
reason: T13 (Chilean national broadcaster) reports parents' complaints that AI-made sexual material of Colegio Alicante del Sol pupils (grades 1-4 medio) was produced and circulated; the protest/clash details could not be verified and are removed, and the source date is 2026-10-03.

title: Storm-0940 uses ARTEX agentic AI in ConnectWise supply chain compromise
reason: Microsoft Threat Intelligence's own 2026-10-21 post describes Storm-0940 using ARTEX agentic AI to speed a ConnectWise supply chain compromise with Microsoft 365 credential abuse, and it differs from the known unknown-actor ARTEX South Korea finance case.

title: Kyrgyz woman, 23, says AI-undressed photo was sent to acquaintances
reason: Kaktus.media, a major Kyrgyz outlet, published the 23-year-old woman's account of an AI-made sexualised deepfake sent to acquaintances and her complaint that the police case is stalling; it is unproven, so the entry is marked alleged.

title: Goiás man arrested for AI-faked armed photo used to threaten ex-partner
reason: Metropoles (2026-10-19) reports a man arrested in flagrante for an AI-forged gun image sent over WhatsApp to threaten his ex-partner, who recognised his tattoo; the draft date of 10-21 is corrected to the publication date.

title: Mendoza retiree defrauded with AI-generated Messi image

title: Spanish opposition PP ad uses deepfakes of PM's wife and other political figures
reason: The Guardian and Spanish outlets confirm the PP released an AI deepfake ad of Begoña Gómez, Zapatero and other Socialist-linked figures, and Gómez filed an identity-theft complaint on 28 October.

title: Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 model leaks other users' content in 155 responses
reason: Cloudflare's own post-incident blog and independent coverage confirm GLM-5.3 on Workers AI returned other customers' data in 155 responses between 27 Aug and 9 Sep, reported by Knostic's Gadi Evron; Cloudflare disclosed it on 26 October, not 27 October.

title: Hugging Face model malware campaign returns to hijack GPUs for crypto mining
reason: BleepingComputer confirmed the payload and reports Pluto Security's findings of a trust_remote_code crypto-mining/backdoor campaign on Hugging Face that returned after takedown, with one model downloaded over 28,000 times; the Solana kit is a separate campaign.
